visual_action: A montage of Donald Trump visiting the 'Fox & Friends' TV studio. He is seen greeting the hosts, sitting on a couch for an interview with Ainsley Earhardt and Lawrence Jones, and interacting with them and Brian Kilmeade. The video includes B-roll of the studio set, the 'Fox & Friends' logo, and concludes with a group photo of Trump, the hosts, and the studio crew all giving a thumbs-up. The video ends with a 'THE WHITE HOUSE' credit screen.
